subject: Journal entry for credit claim
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record VEN042-0029 shows in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09. The supplier reported the invoice one return period late, so the Rs 1,795 credit can be claimed only in the month it appears.

Please claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.

Regards,
Accounts team
